fields.amenities.0.title: Wifi
fields.amenities.1.body:
Television is watched via internet through the SFR box — use the second remote to navigate.

Remember to log out of your accounts before you leave.
fields.amenities.1.title: Television
fields.amenities.2.body:
Temperature is controlled via the wall thermostats — don't touch the radiators themselves.

Ideally 19-21°C in winter. Remember to close windows properly to avoid heating the outside.
fields.amenities.2.title: Heating
fields.amenities.3.body:
EssentielB hob with touch controls: press to adjust the power.

Child lock: long press on the lock button.
fields.amenities.3.title: Hob
fields.amenities.4.body:
Nespresso machine, kettle and cafetière in the kitchen.

We provide coffee capsules and tea for your first night, to help you settle in. After that, capsules are available for purchase nearby.
fields.amenities.4.title: Nespresso Coffee
fields.amenities.5.sub: Beko washing machine in the apartment · bed linen provided
fields.amenities.5.title: Washing machine
fields.amenities.6.body:
To get started — coffee capsules and tea (first night), 2 to 3 rolls of toilet paper for your stay.

For your entire stay — sheets and towels (one bath towel per person), hairdryer, iron.

Everything you need is here to start well; for a longer stay, you'll find everything nearby.
fields.amenities.6.title: What we provide
fields.amenities.7.body:
The bin room is at the bottom of the stairs, in the internal courtyard.

Please take out your rubbish when you leave — out of respect for the cleaning team.
fields.amenities.7.title: Bins & recycling
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.0: Did you press the padlock in the centre after entering the code? That's what validates the entry — without it, the box won't open.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.1: The box unlocked, but did you pull to the side to open it and retrieve the key? Unlocking doesn't open it automatically.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.2: After several wrong codes, the box goes into safety mode. Wait 1 to 2 minutes without touching it, then try again calmly.

fields.parking.summary: Pedestrian zone · free parking 5 min away
fields.parking.text.0: The building is in a pedestrian zone: no parking in front of the door.
fields.parking.text.1: Unloading luggage at the foot of the building is possible when the bollards are open (often in the morning) — but it's not guaranteed. Plan to carry your bags a few hundred metres.
fields.parking.text.2: Robelin and Battant car parks are free, 5 min walk away. Cusenier Beaux-Arts is paid (€1.90/night), 7 min away.
fields.recos.food.0.desc: Art Deco brasserie from 1850, 700 m away. The setting alone is worth the trip — booking recommended.
fields.recos.food.1.desc: All the cheese specialities of Franche-Comté (a traditional French region): fondue, cancoillotte, tartiflette.
fields.recos.food.2.desc: Contemporary bistro, seasonal menu with Asian influences. Great vegetarian options.
fields.recos.food.3.desc: Franche-Comté specialities and homemade lasagne, in a warm vintage setting.
fields.recos.food.4.desc: Chic bistro featuring Burgundy-Franche-Comté terroir, 500 m away. Signed by Bernard Loiseau.
fields.recos.food.5.desc: Authentic French cuisine and cheese fondue, in a warm setting.
fields.recos.food.6.desc: Generous dishes made with local produce, on rue Richebourg.
fields.recos.shop.0.desc: Right next to the building — organic, fresh, local.
fields.recos.shop.1.desc: Several addresses in the district: bread, pastries, coffee to go.
fields.recos.shop.2.desc: Several pharmacies in the immediate vicinity. On-call pharmacist details displayed in the window.
fields.recos.visit.0.desc: Vauban's masterpiece, UNESCO-listed, 2 km away. Three museums and a museum with aquarium.
fields.recos.visit.1.desc: In the splendid Renaissance Palais Granvelle — the history of Besançon watchmaking.
fields.recos.visit.2.desc: Lunch or dinner cruise with commentary on the Doubs, lock passages and tunnel under the Citadel.
fields.recos.visit.3.desc: At Saint-Jean Cathedral. Mechanism with over 30,000 parts (1858-1860).
fields.recos.visit.4.desc: Birthplace of the writer, 140 Grande Rue. Contemporary and moving scenography.
fields.recos.visit.5.desc: Open-air ecomuseum in Nancray: traditional Franche-Comté habitat. Perfect for a half-day.
